title: Improved
summary: IMPROV'ED, participle passive Made better, wiser or more excellent; advanced immoral worth, knowledge or manners. 1. Made better; advanced in fertility or other good qualities. 2. Used to profit or go

inlines.v: IMPROV'ED, participle passive Made better, wiser or more excellent; advanced immoral worth, knowledge or manners. 1. Made better; advanced in fertility or other good qualities. 2. Used to profit or good purpose; as opportunities of learning improved 3. Used; occupied; as improved land.
